Bug_Title: "@Qualifier" should not be used on "@Bean" methods
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by using the @Qualifier annotation on methods annotated with @Bean in a Spring configuration class. According to the bug rule, @Qualifier should not be used on @Bean methods because it is redundant and can lead to confusion. The bean's name can be specified using the name attribute of the @Bean annotation or derived from the method name.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which instantiates the MyConfiguration class and calls its bean methods that incorrectly use the @Qualifier annotation.
